original_value: The notion of a neutrosophic positive implicative    N   -ideal in     B C K    -algebras is introduced, and several properties are investigated. Relations between a neutrosophic    N   -ideal and a neutrosophic positive implicative    N   -ideal are discussed. Characterizations of a neutrosophic positive implicative    N   -ideal are considered. Conditions for a neutrosophic    N   -ideal to be a neutrosophic positive implicative    N   -ideal are provided. An extension property of a neutrosophic positive implicative    N   -ideal based on the negative indeterminacy membership function is discussed.

result.paraphrase: The concept of a neutrosophic positive implicative N-ideal in B C K-algebras is introduced, and its properties are examined. The relationship between a neutrosophic N-ideal and a neutrosophic positive implicative N-ideal is discussed. Characterizations of neutrosophic positive implicative N-ideals are also studied. Conditions under which a neutrosophic N-ideal becomes a neutrosophic positive implicative N-ideal are given. In addition, an extension property of a neutrosophic positive implicative N-ideal based on the negative indeterminacy membership function is discussed.
